The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 85-86. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let n ≥ 4 and let (B, h0, λ0) be a smooth oriented vacuum static exterior, complete including its connected compact boundary S, with a compact complement of one Euclidean coordinate end. Suppose Hessh0 λ0 = λ0 Rich0 , ∆h0 λ0 = 0, λ0|S = 0, λ0 −→ 1, (10.1) and ∂νλ0 = κ0 > 0 on S, with ν pointing toward the end. Assume, after a constant linear normalization of end coordinates, h0 − δ = O2(r−q0 ), λ0 − 1 = O2(r−q0 ), n − 2 2 < q0 < n − 2. (10.2) 85 Then B is globally the exterior of a round sphere in isotropic coordinates. For some R > 0, writing ρ = |x| ≥ R, h0 = ( 1 + Rn−2 ρn−2 )4/(n−2) δ, λ0 = 1 − Rn−2/ρn−2 1 + Rn−2/ρn−2 . (10.3) The identification extends smoothly to S.
